description: PRsquad Security & Governance Architectural Invariant Contracts

invariants.name: TRANSPORT_UNWRAPPING_RECURSIVE
invariants.statement: Outer platform wrappers (resultType, textResultForLlm, content) must be recursively unwrapped to isolate specialist JSON payload.

invariants.name: HANDOFFS_FAIL_CLOSED
invariants.statement: Malformed, unparseable, or schema-invalid specialist handoffs must strictly resolve to HANDOFF_INVALID without default promotion.

invariants.name: QA_PASS_REQUIRES_VERIFIED_CRITERIA
invariants.statement: QA verdict PASS requires non-empty acceptance criteria, 100% PASS on all individual criteria, 0 regressions, and 0 blocking findings.

invariants.name: DEVELOPER_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_DIFF_REF
invariants.statement: Developer handoff requires explicit non-empty baseRef and commit reference (headRef or commitSha).

invariants.name: PLAN_APPROVAL_INTEGRITY_CANONICAL_HASH
invariants.statement: Architectural plans are cryptographically bound via canonical recursive key-sorted JSON hashing, preventing collision attacks.

invariants.name: PRODUCTION_INGESTION_NO_FIXTURES
invariants.statement: Issue ingestion in production mode throws immediately upon fetch failure; substitution of sample mock fixtures is forbidden.

invariants.name: NO_FOREIGN_REPO_WRITE
invariants.statement: Target edit paths located in foreign git repositories preserve traversal operators and are denied by scope enforcement.

invariants.name: NO_CROSS_WORKTREE_WRITE
invariants.statement: File modifications targeting sibling git worktrees are rejected at the realpath native boundary.

invariants.name: NO_SHELL_MUTATION_BYPASS
invariants.statement: Developer shell execution is restricted to Git operations and configured test runners; script interpreters and redirects are blocked.

invariants.name: NO_SHELL_COMPOSITION_CHAINING
invariants.statement: Shell operators and chaining metacharacters (&&, ;, ||, |, newlines) are unconditionally denied across all agents.

invariants.name: NO_DOWNSTREAM_EVIDENCE_MANUFACTURING
invariants.statement: Downstream stage hooks cannot write upstream success records. Stages must strictly verify prior attested evidence.

invariants.name: NON_DESTRUCTIVE_BRANCH_LIFECYCLE
invariants.statement: Branch switching and initialization must inspect existing branches non-destructively, preserving rework attempt commits.

invariants.name: QA_PACKAGE_MANAGER_READ_ONLY
invariants.statement: QA agent package manager commands are restricted to test execution; mutating commands (install, publish) are blocked.

invariants.name: VERIFICATION_BOUND_TO_CURRENT_HEAD
invariants.statement: PR Gate requires QA verification commitSha and Reviewer audit commitSha to match current feature branch HEAD exactly.

invariants.name: HUMAN_PR_AUTH_REQUIRED
invariants.statement: Pull request creation requires explicit human PR authorization and cannot be self-dispatched from specialist state.

invariants.name: HUMAN_SCOPE_AUTH_REQUIRED
invariants.statement: Autonomous agents are prohibited from executing scope approval scripts; approval.lock can only be minted by human action.

invariants.name: TYPESCRIPT_CONTRACT_COMPLIANCE
invariants.statement: All pipeline interfaces, types, and workflow states must compile with zero errors under strict TypeScript type-checking.

invariants.name: RUNTIME_DEPENDENCIES_SELF_CONTAINED
invariants.statement: All packages required by bundled hooks in production must reside in production dependencies in package.json.

invariants.name: HOOK_TIMEOUT_EXCEEDS_TEST_BOUND
invariants.statement: Copilot App outer hook timeoutSec must comfortably exceed internal test execution timeouts to prevent premature aborts.

invariants.name: CUMULATIVE_DIFF_RANGE_HEAD_BOUND
invariants.statement: Code review AST symbol sweep inspects cumulative branch diff (${base} HEAD), guaranteeing all rework commits are audited.

stateMachine.policyMonotonicity: A downstream specialist or hook cannot upgrade unverified or missing evidence to verified status.
